objectives.text: Rewrite a repository query with JOIN FETCH or an @EntityGraph so that a listing loads parents and children in one query
Verify the fix by counting queries in the SQL log before and after
Explain why JOIN FETCH on a collection does not combine safely with database pagination and choose an alternative such as a separate batch query
